method: Native macOS Electron interactions through Computer Use; clicks, drags and native keyboard. No Playwright, DOM evaluation, capture bridge or API-driven UI actions in this pass.
status: Partial manual qualification; no task marked Done
head: badc726
platform: macOS arm64; Electron 41.6.1; development shell, production renderer bundle

fixture.name: QA-f2a-golden
fixture.note: All mutations were in the disposable copy. Two GND ports occupy the same location: the first placement was not immediately visible in Computer Use, and a second placement was made. The command log resolves this observation ambiguity; do not count it as an app duplication defect.

main.result: Schematic and PCB shells load, but both canvas areas remain black with external renderer networking denied. Fit does not recover the schematic. Logs show denied unicode-font-resolver CDN requests.

candidate.result: Candidate renders text and geometry under the same renderer network guard. All subsequent feature observations use this unpublished candidate, not the main dependency or packaged release.

builds.networkScope: Electron default-session renderer/worker external requests blocked; loopback and local protocols allowed. Main-process traffic was not instrumented. This is not an OS-wide offline test.

passedObservations.evidence: Fit changes initial 80% close-up to complete 17% schematic.
R1 selection highlights symbol and exposes value, footprint, placement and pin nets.
R1 moves from -29.988 / 11.980 mm to -26.670 / 15.240 mm on 1.27 mm grid; persisted revision 146.
Canvas-focused R changes R1 from 0 to 90 degrees; persisted revision 147.
Toolbar Undo restores rotation to 0; toolbar Redo restores 90.
Typing GRP test 10k into Value does not invoke placement/rotation tools. Replaced with 12kΩ and committed; outline, PCB and restart retain 12kΩ at revision 150.
Selecting VCC highlights its wire network.
Run ERC completes with 0 displayed violations. Later placement displays schematic-changed warning. This verifies execution/staleness only, not ERC completeness or electrical correctness.
Search resistor, Enter, canvas click creates R4 at 12.700 / -27.940 mm; outline gains one part, revision 151. Escape exits placement.
GND placed; clicking R4.1 then ground anchor creates wire. Inspector shows R4.1 GND. Command revision 154 addresses sourcePinId and primitive target, rather than rounded free points.
View on PCB opens R4 with matching reference, footprint and GND pin data; PCB list includes R1 12kΩ.
Canvas-selected U1 responds to R with 90 degrees, then F with Bottom/B.Cu. Toolbar Undo returns Top/F.Cu; another Undo restores 0 degrees.
Pitch changes 0.25 to 0.5 mm; Show grid off leaves Snap to grid on.
Canvas-focused H then click creates Ø3.2 mm hole at 12.5 / 10.5 mm. Inspector and persisted pcb_add_free_hole agree; revision 160.
Undo removes hole geometry; Redo restores it. Stale selection after Undo recorded separately.
Run DRC replaces old 44 warnings with 11 errors and 55 warnings, including overlap, short circuit, clearance and unrouted GND findings. No waivers or rule changes applied.
Export opens Manufacturing exports unavailable; Download ZIP disabled; explanation explicitly refuses Gerber, drill and placement output.
Route tool starts at J1 pad with VCC status. W changes 0.250 to 0.500 mm. Trace creation is NOT qualified: attempted corner/Enter produces no pcb_add_trace command.
Bottom view mirrors hole from right to left, displays bottom badge and switches active layer; top view restores orientation. Revisions 163-166.
DRC markers toggle off/on visually while DRC result counts remain. Markers restored on before restart; no finding waived.

Restart returns Home at r166. Reopened schematic AX exposes R1 12kΩ, R4 12.700 / -27.940 mm and R4.1 GND. PCB AX restores grid off, snap on, pitch 0.5 mm and stale DRC66. Consistent SQLite backup confirms hole remains. Post-restart canvas visual proof is blocked by stale capture.

failedOrUnresolvedObservations.reproduction: Fresh isolated profile; deny external renderer/worker network; open QA-f2a-golden; Fit schematic; switch PCB. Both canvases black, shells populated. Candidate renders under same guard.

failedOrUnresolvedObservations.finding: Native Cmd+Z/Cmd+Shift+Z did not change canvas history
failedOrUnresolvedObservations.reproduction: Rotate R1 with canvas focused; Cmd+Z leaves 90 degrees; toolbar Undo changes to 0. Cmd+Shift+Z leaves 0; toolbar Redo changes to 90. PCB Cmd+Z similarly leaves flipped U1 unchanged; toolbar Undo restores Top. Treat as failed in this native-input pass, despite earlier Playwright keyboard pass; investigate Electron menu/accelerator path. Capture/input transport uncertainty remains; root cause not established.
Tab remains r145 during confirmed writes through r166; Home after restart reports r166. Command log confirms commits were persisted.

failedOrUnresolvedObservations.finding: Removed hole remains selected after Undo
failedOrUnresolvedObservations.reproduction: Select new hole, toolbar Undo. Geometry disappears, but inspector says 1 item selected / Holes 1 and status says Hole. Redo restores geometry.

failedOrUnresolvedObservations.finding: PCB drag and completed route not demonstrated
failedOrUnresolvedObservations.reproduction: Dense overlapping fixture caused attempted footprint drags to select another placement or trace; no pcb_move_placement persisted. Routing activates and width changes, but corner/Enter attempt leaves no created trace. Retest on a clear fixture with stable visual capture before attributing failure.

failedOrUnresolvedObservations.finding: Schematic text and glyph fidelity remain unqualified
failedOrUnresolvedObservations.reproduction: Fitted view shows overlapping NE555 top-pin names and literal ~{RST}; rotated R1 reference/value overlap. Capacitor symbol strokes appear incomplete at fit scale. No source/candidate comparison proving cause was performed.

failedOrUnresolvedObservations.finding: Post-restart screenshots stop reflecting AX changes
failedOrUnresolvedObservations.reproduction: Screenshot remains initial schematic 80% close-up after AX reports fitted 17%, R4 inspector, then PCB. Rebind, Raise, zoom-window and CUA kernel reset do not repair capture. Intermittent noWindowsAvailable and user-changed-window errors also occur. Do not classify this as a confirmed app rendering defect without a foreground recapture.
